reviews.text: I took my 1.5 yr old Shih Tzu  to PetCare now for emergency care.  From the minute we walked in, we were greeted by Karen at the front desk. She was very compassionate and caring. The vet tech  took her in for immediate evaluation and came out to show me she had a high fever. The vet on that night was also amazing, discussed what was done and asked if wanted more tests but only what was truly needed.  They sent us home with what we needed and Discharge instructions. They called a few days later to see how she was doing. Even made it easy to get documents needed for my pet insurance claim. Highly recommended!
Took our puppy to get neutered and everything was great. They took great care of him!
Amazing office. Staff is caring and supportive. Highly recommend!!

Dr was great! Great attention...great communication. ...front desk lady  could be more pleasant...she acts like she is being bothered .... with any question or anything! This clinic is ALSO ON THE VERY EXPENSIVE SIDE...

Dr. Torres and Dr. Williams and staff are great. They were very attentive and caring to our pets. We have been to both locations and have been taken well care of. Pricing is fair and up front. It is apparent how much all the staff cares for their patients. Added bonus the cute kitties that are there for support.
Excellent care and attention for my miniature poodle! I recommend them 100%!
Very happy with the friendliness and service. They treated my cat promptly, kept me updated on her progress, and gave me recommendations for future care. Extremely happy to have found Pet Care Now!
Thank you so much for the five-star rating, Mona!
Dr Williams and his team are friendly and efficient.   The clinic has very convenient hours.  They are also available for emergencies.
I will always be grateful for the  Love and care the whole team gave my dog🙏❤️ …
We truly appreciate the high rating, Genesis! Thank you for entrusting Pet Care Now!
5-stars. Great team and service. Looking forward to our next vet visit!

I couldn’t recommend this place enough. My dog had an emergency with an open wound, and they took me right in. The service was excellent from the front desk to the doctor and the Dr’s assistant. They are very compassionate and knowledgeable.

We can’t thank this team enough for taking such great care of our Margo during her spay. Everything went perfectly, and the staff was compassionate and attentive throughout the process. Highly recommend!
Amazing people. We love this team!

I can’t say enough good things about this clinic and their incredible staff. My puppy, fractured his ulna and radius and from the very beginning we felt completely supported and informed.

Dr. Cesar Torres and the entire team were amazing. Their attention to detail and the way they explained everything made a stressful situation much easier to handle. Every step of the process was clearly communicated, and they truly showed how much they care about both pets and their owners.

The surgery was performed by Dr. Jose Gorostiza in October 2025, and the recovery could not have gone better. Our puppy  only needed a cast for 10 days and was back to his normal, happy self in no time.

I’m extremely grateful to everyone involved and would absolutely recommend this clinic to anyone looking for compassionate, knowledgeable veterinary care.

Amazing practice! The owner was incredibly compassionate and helped me get an emergency appointment right away for a cat from my neighborhood. From the moment I arrived, the entire team was warm, patient, and truly caring. They saw us quickly and handled everything with such professionalism that the drive actually took longer than the visit itself that’s how efficient they were.

Even though it was an hour away, it was absolutely worth the trip. I left feeling relieved, grateful, and genuinely impressed with the level of service and kindness they showed. I highly recommend this practice to anyone who wants their pets treated with real care and urgency.

Pet care Now is the best vet care in south Florida. The doctors and staff are incredibly competent and caring. Dr Williams and Dr Torres  are the best. They concentrate on providing the best care for your pet.  I wouldn't trust any other vet  service.
I’ve seen the reviews… the doctors are very professional, but the person at the front desk is very rude… I had an appointment and I preferred to cancel it.
I agree with the previous comments… The person at the front desk should improve her customer service… and also with the pets… She looks at my pet with disdain
